releases.notes:
A minor update for v1.4. This update fixes a server crash for improperly generated Crystallized Amber blocks.

Changes
-
- Using a Sculk Transmitter no longer sends unnecessary chunk load requests
- Removed Anger, Fear, and Sorrow Pot entities from the Sculk Slayer advancement (kill all Sculk mobs)
  - This change is only temporary until these pots are able to spawn in the world

Bug Fixes

- Fixed empty loot generation for Crystallized Amber blocks - #521 

**A full list of changes can be found here**: https://github.com/KyaniteMods/DeeperAndDarker/compare/v1.4...v1.4.1

mods.name: Deeper and Darker
mods.description: A Minecraft mod featuring new blocks, items, armor, and hidden mysteries to complement the Deep Dark.

releases.notes:
A new update after a long time! This update brings many Otherside improvements along with new blocks, items, effects, and enchantments. Some key new features include Dyeable Sculk Transmitters, an Ancient Compass to point to Ancient Temples, an improved way of obtaining Resonarium armor and tools, and new enchantments for the Soronous Staff. Sculk Transmitters have received a major update; they are now able to link to other modded containers and are no longer limited to just vanilla storage blocks. There are more blocks that have been added for more decoration and functionality, such as the new Lite block, which emits light and can be crafted into other light-emitting blocks with unique textures.

The Otherside dimension has gone through a full overhaul, with much more open spaces, uniform biome distribution, and improved natural features. Changes have been made to how a new Otherside portal is generated when traveling between dimensions, which should result in more exposed spawns rather than spawning in some cramped location. A transition screen has also been added to be shown when traveling between the Otherside and the Overworld, similar to the transition screen shown when traveling to and from the Nether.

### New Blocks
- added Enriched Gloomslate Bricks
- added Gloomslate Brick Fence
- added Gloomslate Light
- added Porous Sculk Gleam
  - found in Sculk Gleam clusters in the Otherside
  - it will naturally generate Gleam Gel through 6 stages
- added Gleam Gel Block
  - crafted by using 9 Gleam Gels
  - it is a gooey block, allowing the player to step through it like Cobwebs and can suppress fall damage
  - acts like and cannot stick to Slime blocks and Honey blocks
- added Lite Block
- added Bordered Lite Block
- added Gloomslate Pot
  - these new pots behave just like Decorated Pots but with new designs
  - Gloomslate Pots are able to store one stack of any item

### New Items
- added Ancient Compass
  - this new compass can be crafted with 4 Warden Carapaces and a Compass
  - the compass will point to the nearest, undiscovered Ancient Temple
- added Gleam Gel
  - obtained from a Porous Sculk Gleam block by using shears
- added Lite
- added Dyeable Sculk Transmitters
  - once a Sculk Transmitter is obtained, combine it with any dye to get a colored transmitter
- added Gloomsherds
  - there are a total of 9 Gloomsherd variants that can be obtained from killing Overcast Pots: blank, brittle, dark heart, listener, snapper, temple, transmission, ward, and wayfinder
  - some Gloomsherds can be found crystallized in Crystallized Amber in the Overcast Columns biome
  - these 9 Gloomsherds can be used to craft a Gloomslate Pot, similar to Decorated Pots
- added Angler Fish
  - obtained after killing an Angler Fish in the Blooming Caverns
- added Cooked Angler Fish
  - obtained by smelting Angler Fish
- added Resonarium Upgrade smithing template
  - Resonarium armor and tools are now obtained by upgrading diamond armor and tools in a smithing table. To upgrade from diamond to resonarium, use the smithing template along with a Resonarium Plate

### New Entities
- added Overcast Pots
  - there are 3 variants, from smaller to bigger: Sorrow Pot, Fear Pot, and Anger Pot
  - the larger the pot, the more health it has
  - killing these Overcast Pots drop Gloomsherds, which can be used to make Gloomslate Pots

### New Effect
- added Sculk Omen
  - obtained while having the Bad Omen effect and being inside an Ancient Temple
  - Sculk Omen increases the chance for Ancient Vases to be fake (spawning more Sculk Leeches and Stalkers)

### New Enchantments
- added Volume
  - Volume increases the maximum damage of the Sonorous Staff
- added Reverberation
  - Reverberation increases the maximum range of the Sonorous Staff
- enchantments are now obtainable
  - Catalysis, can only be found from villager trades and Ancient Temple basement chests

releases.notes:
Third minor update for Deeper and Darker 1.3. This update improves the Sonorous Staff and fixes some bugs.

### Content
- the Sonorous Staff can now be repaired and enchanted
  - repair the staff with a Soul Crystal in an anvil
  - the staff can be enchanted with Mending and Unbreaking
- Sludges and Phantoms are now considered Sculk mobs
  - they will no longer be targeted by vibration-detecting mobs (Shattered, Stalkers, and Wardens)
- updated translations for multiple languages

### Bug Fixes
- fixed Otherside dimension effects overlapping with the Nether's - #386
- fixed Otherside portal duplication - #378
- fixed Mekanism compatibility recipes not being recognized - #370

**A full list of changes can be found here**: https://github.com/KyaniteMods/DeeperAndDarker/compare/v1.3.2...v1.3.3
